key_insight: The paper shows that decentralized online optimization on Riemannian manifolds can achieve the optimal $O(\log T)$ regret for strongly geodesically convex losses, even with online and bandit feedback.
engineering_relevance: This gives a principled convergence guarantee for distributed learning on curved spaces, which is useful for networked robotics, sensing, and geometric machine learning systems.
method: Derive a new network-error analysis that works with time-varying step sizes.
Use decentralized online Riemannian gradient descent with a decaying schedule to match the strongly g-convex regime.
Extend the result to two-point bandit feedback via strong subconvexity of smoothed losses.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports first-time $O(\log T)$ static regret bounds in both full-information decentralized online Riemannian optimization and two-point bandit feedback settings.
watch_item: The guarantees rely on bounded sectional curvature and carefully chosen decaying step sizes, so practical performance may depend on geometry and network conditions.
paper_title: Decentralized Online Riemannian Optimization for Strongly Geodesically Convex Functions
